title: Loopholing All the Way: Language Modeling with pure Self-Conditioning
abstract: arXiv:2610.30068v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) use Self-Conditioning (SC), or Loopholing, to improve their performance. While SC is traditionally seen as an auxiliary heuristic, its empirical success raises the question: can a continuous generative model be based purely on Self-Conditioning? We answer affirmatively with LAW (``Loopholing All the Way''), which propagates the Expected Embedding under the denoiser's prediction across steps, decoding the tokens once, at the end. On Sudoku, LAW outperforms previous Discrete and Continuous Diffusion Models, including Loopholing Discrete Diffusion. On Maze, LAW is the most accurate from 2 to 64 NFE. After training on TinyGSM and sampling at temperature 1 with 1024 NFE, LAW solves 42.2% of GSM8K problems against 34.5% for uniform Loopholing Discrete Diffusion. Additionally, fine-tuning a pre-trained Uniform Diffusion Model (Duo) with LAW increases its accuracy from 17.2% to 48.1%. Finally, on OpenWebTe

translated_title: 一路"Loopholing"到底：基于纯自条件化的语言建模
translated_abstract: 近期的扩散语言模型（DLMs）使用自条件化（Self-Conditioning, SC），即Loopholing，来提升性能。虽然SC传统上被视为一种辅助性启发式技巧，但其实证上的成功引出了一个问题：能否构建一个完全基于自条件化的连续生成模型？我们给出了肯定的回答，提出了LAW（"Loopholing All the Way"，即"一路Loopholing到底"），该方法将去噪器预测下的期望嵌入在多个步骤之间进行传播，并在最后一次性解码所有token。在数独（Sudoku）任务上，LAW优于以往包括Loopholing离散扩散模型在内的离散和连续扩散模型。在迷宫（Maze）任务上，LAW在2到64次函数评估（NFE）范围内准确率最高。在TinyGSM上训练并以温度1、1024次NFE采样后，LAW解决了42.2%的GSM8K问题，而均匀Loopholing离散扩散模型仅为34.5%。此外，使用LAW微调预训练的均匀扩散模型（Duo）可将其准确率从17.2%提升至48.1%。最后，在OpenWebTe
tldr: 提出LAW方法，将自条件化从辅助技巧提升为连续生成模型的核心机制，通过在去噪步骤间传播期望嵌入并在最后一次性解码，在数独、迷宫和GSM8K等任务上超越了现有的离散与连续扩散语言模型。
en_tdlr: LAW elevates Self-Conditioning from an auxiliary heuristic into the core of a continuous generative model by propagating expected embeddings across denoising steps and decoding tokens once at the end, outperforming both discrete and continuous diffusion language models on Sudoku, Maze, and GSM8K.
